title: Coprimality Propagation to Products
content: coprime_prod_of_coprime_all proves that if n is coprime to every element of a list ns, then n is coprime to ns.prod. Proved by induction on ns using Nat.Coprime.mul_right. head_coprime_tail_prod specializes this to the pairwise case: if n :: ns is pairwise coprime, then n is coprime to ns.prod. This is the key enabling lemma for the k-fold CRT induction.
mathContext: If $\gcd(n, n_i) = 1$ for all $i$, then $\gcd(n, \prod_i n_i) = 1$. Proof: $\gcd(n, n_1 \cdot \prod_{i>1} n_i) = 1$ from $\gcd(n, n_1) = 1$ and $\gcd(n, \prod_{i>1} n_i) = 1$ (by IH).

title: k-fold CRT Ring Isomorphism (General)
content: crtKFold constructs ZMod ns.prod ≃+* CRTProd ns by induction on the list ns. Base case: ZMod 1 ≅ PUnit via zmod_one_equiv_punit (ZMod 1 is Subsingleton). Inductive step: decompose n :: ns as ZMod (n * ns.prod) ≅ ZMod n × ZMod ns.prod via chineseRemainder (using head_coprime_tail_prod for coprimality), then apply IH to the second factor via RingEquiv.prodCongr.
mathContext: $\mathbb{Z}/(\prod_i n_i)\mathbb{Z} \cong \prod_i \mathbb{Z}/n_i\mathbb{Z}$ for pairwise coprime $n_i$. Base: $\mathbb{Z}/1\mathbb{Z} \cong \{0\}$. Step: $\mathbb{Z}/(n \cdot \prod n_i)\mathbb{Z} \cong \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/(\prod n_i)\mathbb{Z} \cong \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \prod_i \mathbb{Z}/n_i\mathbb{Z}$.

title: k-fold Euler Totient Multiplicativity
content: totient_prod_pairwise_coprime proves φ(∏ nᵢ) = ∏ φ(nᵢ) for pairwise coprime lists, by induction using Nat.totient_mul for the coprime pair at each step. This is a classical corollary of the CRT: the isomorphism preserves units, and φ(n) counts units in ℤ/nℤ.
mathContext: $\varphi(\prod_i n_i) = \prod_i \varphi(n_i)$ when the $n_i$ are pairwise coprime. This follows from $\varphi(mn) = \varphi(m)\varphi(n)$ for $\gcd(m,n)=1$.
